GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (IronWave.cs:14) == the class attribute -- notable because this is an ATTACK that gains block, so the flag cannot be inferred from the card type.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (IronWave.cs:22-25) == cost 1 / ATTACK / COMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(5m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new BlockVar(5m, ValueProp.Move)` (IronWave.cs:16-20) == both numbers, both declared. The BlockVar is Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches and it is the counter-intuitive one: BLOCK FIRST (`CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)`, IronWave.cs:30), THEN the attack (31-33). The sim has it the same way round (iron_wave.py:359-360), which matters because thorns or a Flame Barrier retaliation from the attack lands against the block this card just gained. Presentation, folded in: WithHitFx.
